event.title: The Long Haul
event.text:
A GATOS shipyard is building something it can't sell: an Armoured ZeroPoint Core far too big for any ship it makes. The yard boss hails you, half proud and half desperate.
"We built it for a jump nobody's made yet. Nobody around here can afford it now. You look like people heading somewhere far."

outcome.text: The yard crew load the Long Haul into your hold. "Make it count," the yard boss says.

choice.text: Let {crew} tell them where you're going.

outcome.text: {crew} tells them about The Colony Ship and the rim. The yard boss is quiet for a long time, then halves the price. "For the ones who actually might make it."

event.title: Grown, Not Built
event.text:
An Azurethea outpost is tending something in its hold: an engine still half grown, its veins pulsing slowly. Its keeper hails you.
"Once we would never have shared this. The collapse has changed what even we will trade. Our refugees need passage more than we need secrets. Pay for it, and the engine is yours."

outcome.text: Your Mawjig buys passage for a whole convoy of Azurethea refugees. The keeper seals the Wingbeat Engine into your hold. "Fly it gently. It remembers."
{crew} and the keeper talk until the outpost's lights dim for the night. In the morning the engine is in your hold, and nobody mentions a price.

event.title: A Good Deal
event.text: A Mecha yard boss hails you, already smiling. "We heard you want our hull bracing. Everyone wants it. Nobody gets it for free. Make us a good offer."

outcome.text: "Pleasure doing business." The bracing is loaded aboard, and the yard boss is still laughing when you jump.
{crew} and the yard boss trade clipped Mecha code for an hour. When it's over, both of them seem sure they won.

choice.text: Copy their bracing plans and fit it yourself.

outcome.text: Your probe copies the plans before the yard notices. Your crews fit the bracing at the next quiet cluster.
"Theft? From us?" The yard boss sounds almost impressed. The frames come for you.

event.title: The Mantle
event.text: Two Tentauri hail you, their voices soft and in step. "We have a shield we cannot carry where we are going. We would give it to someone who flies with us, once."

choice.text: Fly a joint operation with them.

outcome.text: You cross the cluster beside them without trouble. At the far side they pass the Mantle Shield to your ship and drift on alone.
Raiders find you halfway across. The Tentauri fight beside you, and when it's over they pass you the Mantle Shield.
{crew} answers in the same soft voice. The Tentauri pass you the Mantle Shield at once, and stay long enough to fit it.

event.title: The Archive Seed
event.text: A Senti archive station hails you, its light lines bright. "We, The Senti-, keep a seed of our archive for anyone who means to leave this galaxy. It is not sold. It is traded, record for record."

outcome.text: You transmit everything your ships carry about the world you left. The station reads it all, then sends the Archive Seed in return. "We, The Senti-, will remember your world. Now you will remember ours."

choice.text: Trade your sensor logs of the collapse.

outcome.text: "We, The Senti-, did not have this," the station says, and sends the seed.
{crew} links with the station and comes back carrying the Archive Seed inside their own records. "I will keep it safe," they say.

event.title: Stolen Goods
event.text: A Lykario trader grins over the channel. "The best autopilot in the galaxy. Flies your ship while you're off hunting. Stolen, of course, so it's cheap."

outcome.text: "Pleasure! Don't ask who it was stolen from." The Tracker Autopilot goes into your hold.

choice.text: Let {crew} offer a joint hunt for it.

outcome.text: {crew} and the trader trade boasts until the trader laughs. "Fine, fine. Good sport is worth more than Mawjig." The autopilot is yours.

choice.text: Steal it back from the thieves.

outcome.text: Your team teleports into their hold and out again with the autopilot before anyone notices. The Lykario would be proud of you.
Your team grabs the autopilot, but the pack catches them on the way out. Now it's a hunt.

event.title: The Brood Heart
event.text: A huge Malphen ship lies dormant in an overgrown wreck field, barely moving. Deep inside it, your sensors read a growth organ still beating. Nobody sells one of those. You'll have to cut it out.

choice.text: Send a team in to cut it out.

outcome.text: Your team cuts its way through the living hull and back out again with the Brood Heart sealed in a crate. Behind them, the ship begins to wake.
The ship wakes while your team is inside. They get out with the Brood Heart, and the ship comes after it.

choice.text: Teleport straight to the organ and out again.

outcome.text: Your team teleports in beside the beating organ, cuts it loose and is gone before the ship stirs.

event.title: No Words
event.text: The Malphen ship is torn open and leaking, but it is still fighting. Deep inside it, your sensors read a growth organ still beating.

choice.text: Demand the organ, or you will finish them off.

outcome.text:
The Malphen don't answer. They never do. The ship stops firing, turns and begins to drift away from you.
Then, without a sound, it splits open and lets the growth organ float free. By the time your crews have it aboard, the ship has powered up its drive and is gone.

event.title: The Long Odds
event.text:
A heavy GATOS ship drops out of a jump right beside your squad, its hull darkened and its emblem scorched. Its captain hails you.
"Commodore Marlowe, of the Long Odds. You've been collecting things. Pieces of every race's tech. Nobody does that unless they've found a way out of this galaxy. Tell me how."

outcome.text: "Then I'll take it out of your wreckage."

choice.text: Tell him to find his own way out.

outcome.text: "I tried. Everyone tried. You're the only ones who found anything." His weapons come online.

choice.text: Let {crew} speak to him, GATOS to GATOS.

outcome.text:
{crew} tells him about The Colony Ship and the people aboard it. For a moment he hesitates.
"So you have a whole ship of people to save. I have a fleet. Why should yours go first?"

event.title: The Long Odds
event.text:
The Long Odds breaks off, trailing smoke, and jumps away before you can finish it. Marlowe's last message is short.
"I'll find out what you know. One way or another."

event.title: Marlowe's Threat
event.text:
The Long Odds is waiting for you, its scars patched in a hurry. Marlowe doesn't bother with a greeting.
"I know where your colony ship is. I've seen its jump signatures behind you. Give me your way out, or I go back for it, and everyone aboard pays for your silence."

choice.text: Tell him The Colony Ship is out of his reach.

outcome.text: "Nothing is out of reach now. Not for me."

choice.text: Ask him why he's so afraid.

outcome.text: A long silence. "Because I've watched the collapse eat everything I ever had. I'm not watching it eat me." His weapons come online.

choice.text: Take control of him and make him call it off.

outcome.text: For a few seconds Marlowe orders his crew to stand down. Then he shakes it off, furious, and opens fire himself.
Your squad's weapons come online, and so do his.

event.title: Marlowe's Threat
event.text: The Long Odds escapes again, barely. This time Marlowe sends no message. Your sensors track his jump: not back toward The Colony Ship, but toward the rim, ahead of you.

event.title: Marlowe's Last Stand
event.text:
The rim is here. With all seven pieces aboard, your squad could make the crossing, and The Colony Ship could follow you.
Then the Long Odds drops out of a jump in front of you, and the rest of Marlowe's fleet drops in around it: every desperate ship that still answered his call. Marlowe sounds exhausted.
"I'm not asking anymore. Seven pieces, and a way out. I'm taking them."

choice.text: Offer him a place behind The Colony Ship.

outcome.text: "Behind you? Behind you is where the collapse is." He laughs, and it doesn't sound like laughing.

choice.text: Let {crew} speak to him one last time.

outcome.text:
{crew} reminds him what the GATOS were once: an alliance of people who looked after each other.
"That was before," Marlowe says. "Everything was before."

choice.text: Tell him he'll have to take them.

outcome.text: "I know," he says quietly. "I always knew."

event.title: The Rim
event.text: The rim is here, but there is no way out yet. Without all seven pieces your squad can't cross the dark between galaxies. Go back and find the ones you're missing.
